title: Installable today: the SAFE evidence fabric as packages anyone can install

appendix_to.rule: The frozen pack is not edited. This appendix is a separate record beside it and adds nothing to the pack's SHA256SUMS.

artefacts.npm: package csoai-verify prepared, not published: publishing needs the owner's npm token

tested.csoai-evidence-fabric: clean venv, Python 3.9 and 3.12: the packaged renderers reproduce all 7 canonical golden files byte for byte; an UNMEASURED event carrying a number is refused by 5/5 renderers; verify returns VALID on a signed fixture and rejects 3/3 tamper controls
tested.llama-stack-provider-csoai: clean venv, llama-stack 0.7.3 (mcp 1.30.0): llama stack run, then POST benchmark and job, returned CONSISTENT, DIVERGENT, UNMEASURED, INVALID, UNVERIFIABLE_KEY
tested.nat-csoai-evidence: clean venv, nvidia-nat 1.9.0 with the [eval] extra: nat eval --skip_workflow returned the same five results with average_score None
tested.llama-stack-csoai-eval: helm lint --strict; rendered; the container start command installed the provider from PyPI and served a job outside Kubernetes
tested.csoai-verify.mjs: node --test against the built file: the SAFE pack FREEZE.signed.json is VALID; a one-byte record edit, a one-nibble signature edit and an unpinned key are rejected

not_measured: No artefact has been installed on a live OpenShift, Kubernetes, Falcon, Splunk, AI Defense or Foundry tenant.
No official marketplace or directory lists any of these artefacts.
The Helm chart carries no provenance (.prov) signature yet; its sha256 is in index.yaml and in this signed record.
